messages:
Samira (partnerships): Quick sync request 10m7: FortressHSM reached out about listing in Private Marketplace. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM group sync, and KMS key-wrapping via their HSM. Can we assemble a pilot plan? cc @Ben @Jun @Ravi @Elena
Ben (security): I can own the security preflight. Need HSM FIPS level, attestation, HSM API (PKCS#11 vs gRPC), and a recommended key-wrap flow (we prefer envelope with our KMS forwarder). Also add pentest gate.
Jun (solutions-eng): We'll build the integration runbook and test harness. Request from partner: SCIM sample payloads and SAML IdP metadata. We'll validate group->role mapping and deprovision behavior.
Ravi (infra): On infra: our Private Marketplace uses the key-forwarder with envelope keys. If Fortress wants direct PKCS#11, we need a connector VM and a mount plan. Also need to know if they support mTLS for HSM RPCs.
Kai (fortresshsm): Hi all 1am Kai from Fortress7. We support PKCS#11 and an optional HSM gateway over mTLS. We'll provide an attestation PDF, SCIM examples, and SAML metadata. We can do key-wrap with your KMS or accept wrapped keys.
Samira (partnerships): Can we agree owners and a tentative timeline? Suggested: Security checklist (Ben) 1 business day7, Runbook + harness (Jun) 3 business days7, Infra connector + certs (Ravi) 2 business days7, Marketing embargo draft (Elena) 1 business day7.
Ben (security): I'll post the checklist by EOD. Key items: attestation, firmware versions, ROCA/known vuln check, SAML certificate fingerprint, SCIM rate limits, and pentest scope.
Jun (solutions-eng): For staging tests, we'll use a sandbox org and run these commands: ```
# sample SCIM User create
curl -X POST "https://staging-fortress.example/scim/v2/Users" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"userName":"dev+test@redwood.com","name":{"givenName":"Dev","familyName":"Test"}}'
```
Jun (solutions-eng): We'll also validate SAML SSO flow and group mapping to RBAC.
Ravi (infra): Please upload your CSR to the secure share. If mTLS is required we will issue client certs. I'll prepare a PKCS#11 emulator for early smoke tests.
Elena (marketing): Draft embargo window: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07. Need logo, short partner blurb, and an exec quote.
Kai (fortresshsm): We'll upload attestation, CSR, SCIM samples, and a short quote by tomorrow morning. Looking forward to the pilot.
